findings.title: button float:right inside .small-action is ignored now that the container is flex
findings.body: The PR makes .small-action a flex container (@include flexbox()). Floats have no effect on flex items, so the 'button { float: right; }' rule inside .small-action (and the leftover 'float: left' on .topic-avatar) is now dead. The button (the small-action undo/edit control) previously sat at the right edge of the row; after this change it renders as a normal flex item immediately after .small-action-desc instead of being right-aligned. To preserve the layout the button needs 'margin-left: auto' (or .small-action-desc needs flex-grow: 1). The 'clear: both' on .small-action and the float rules should also be cleaned up or verified.

findings.title: Header .contents is now a non-wrapping flex row with no shrink/overflow handling
findings.body: .d-header .contents now uses display:flex with align-items:center but no flex-wrap (defaults to nowrap) and no min-width:0 on the items. Previously .title floated left and .panel floated right, so on narrow viewports content could drop/reflow; as flex items, .title, .extra-info-wrapper (which contains the topic title text and can be long) and .panel cannot wrap, and modern flex items refuse to shrink below their min-content size without min-width:0. On narrow screens or with a long topic title shown in the docked header, this can cause horizontal overflow or squished/overlapping header elements instead of graceful reflow. Consider adding min-width:0 plus text-overflow handling to .extra-info-wrapper/.title, or an appropriate flex-wrap/flex-shrink strategy.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits a nonexistent -ms-align-items property and mismatched old-box values
findings.body: The new align-items mixin emits '-ms-align-items: $alignment', which is not a real CSS property in any browser (IE10 implements '-ms-flex-align', which the mixin already includes) — it is dead code that suggests IE support the mixin doesn't actually verify. Additionally, '-webkit-box-align' (2009 flexbox) only accepts start/end/center/baseline/stretch; it does not accept 'flex-start'/'flex-end', so any future caller passing those values will get no alignment at all in browsers that fall back to 'display: -webkit-box'. Similarly the flexbox mixin emits 'display: -moz-box' but there is no accompanying '-moz-box-align', so the old-Firefox fallback is only half implemented. Either trim the unsupported fallbacks or add the correct value mapping.

findings.title: Leftover .valign-helper rule is meaningless inside the new flex container
findings.body: .valign-helper (display:inline-block; height:100%; vertical-align:middle) was a hack for vertically centering header content under the old float layout. Now that .contents is a flex container with align-items:center, this element becomes a flex item: vertical-align does not apply to flex items and height:100% resolves against an indefinite container height (auto). The rule is dead weight from an incomplete refactor and should be removed along with the corresponding element in the header template if it is no longer needed.
